questions.question: What did Ezra do before the assembled people at the Water Gate?
options: Offered sacrifices on the great bronze altar
Led the army out against the enemy
Crowned a new king over Judah
Read from the Book of the Law of Moses
questions.answer: Read from the Book of the Law of Moses

questions.question: How did Nehemiah and Ezra tell the people to respond instead of weeping?
options: To rejoice, for the joy of the LORD is their strength
To fast and to humble themselves even further
To mourn and weep for a full period of seven days
To go home and rest quietly from the long reading
questions.answer: To rejoice, for the joy of the LORD is their strength

questions.question: The Levites helped the people understand the Law as it was read.
The people wept when they heard the words of the _____.
They kept the Feast of _____ (Booths), which had not been done so since the days of Joshua.
